description: This file defines an interface in Java that specifies callback methods to signal the start and end of a row addition animation in an Android list view. It facilitates managing UI behavior during cell animations.

classes.name: OnRowAdditionAnimationListener
classes.description: An interface that provides callback methods to indicate the start and end of a row addition animation.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationStart
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a row addition animation begins.

methods.name: onRowAdditionAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback method invoked when a row addition animation ends.
